assets.description: The open-plan mill floor seen down its length to the green end wall: desk clusters between two rows of black steel columns, five 20-pane windows along the left throwing low afternoon sun across the left half of the floor.

The window-end desk of a cluster by the south windows, seen seated from behind and right: lit monitor against a deep green felt divider, empty low-backed chair, midday sun raking across the desk from window N.
The open floor at night, almost empty: one desk lit by a brass lamp and its monitor on the window side, the rest falling into cool dark toward the bare brick end wall and its glowing exit sign.
